node.title: Checkout Flow
node.description: End-to-end functional and security testing suite for the complete checkout process, including form validation, price accuracy, SQL injection and XSS prevention.

node.title: Successful checkout with valid customer data
node.description: Validate the complete happy path checkout flow from cart to order confirmation.
node.preconditions: User is logged in as standard_user. At least one product is in the cart.
node.postconditions: Order confirmation page displayed. Cart is cleared.

node.action: Fill in First Name: "Marcie", Last Name: "QA", Zip Code: "10001" and click Continue
Verify order summary shows correct items, subtotal, tax and total. Click "Finish"
node.expected_result: User is redirected to /checkout-complete.html. Confirmation message displayed.

node.action: Click "Back Home" and verify cart is empty
node.expected_result: Cart badge is not visible. Cart page shows no items.

node.title: Checkout blocked with all fields empty
node.description: Validate that the form cannot be submitted without any customer data.
node.preconditions: User is on checkout step one. All fields are empty.
node.postconditions: Form submission blocked. Error message displayed.

node.action: Leave all fields empty and click "Continue"
node.expected_result: Error message displayed: "First Name is required". User remains on step one.

node.title: Checkout blocked when First Name is missing
node.description: Validate mandatory field validation for First Name.
node.preconditions: User is on checkout step one.

node.action: Fill Last Name and Zip Code, leave First Name empty. Click "Continue"
node.expected_result: Error message displayed: "First Name is required".

node.title: Checkout blocked when Last Name is missing
node.description: Validate mandatory field validation for Last Name.
node.preconditions: User is on checkout step one.

node.action: Fill First Name and Zip Code, leave Last Name empty. Click "Continue"
node.expected_result: Error message displayed: "Last Name is required".

node.title: Checkout blocked when Zip Code is missing
node.description: Validate mandatory field validation for Zip Code.
node.preconditions: User is on checkout step one.

node.action: Fill First Name and Last Name, leave Zip Code empty. Click "Continue"
node.expected_result: Error message displayed: "Postal Code is required".

node.title: Price calculation accuracy on order summary
node.description: Validate that subtotal, tax and total are calculated correctly on the order summary page.
node.preconditions: User is logged in. Two known products are in the cart. User is on checkout step two.

node.action: Add "Sauce Labs Backpack" ($29.99) and "Sauce Labs Bike Light" ($9.99) to cart. Proceed to checkout step two.

node.expected_result: All price values match expected calculations. No rounding errors.

node.title: Cancel checkout returns user to cart
node.description: Validate that clicking Cancel on step one returns the user to the cart with items intact.
node.preconditions: User is on checkout step one. One product is in the cart.
node.postconditions: User returned to cart. Items still present.

node.expected_result: User is returned to /cart.html. Cart items are still present.

node.title: SQL Injection prevention on checkout form fields
node.description: Validate that SQL injection payloads in checkout form fields are handled safely.
node.preconditions: User is on checkout step one.
node.postconditions: System does not crash. Payload treated as plain text.

node.action: Enter `' OR 1=1 --` in First Name, Last Name and Zip Code fields. Click "Continue"
node.expected_result: System does not crash or expose database errors. Input is treated as plain text. Form may proceed or show a validation error.

node.title: XSS prevention on checkout form fields
node.description: Validate that script injection in checkout fields is not executed by the browser.
node.preconditions: User is on checkout step one.
node.postconditions: Script is not executed. Input treated as plain text.

node.action: Enter `<script>alert('XSS')</script>` in First Name field. Fill remaining fields with valid data. Click "Continue"
node.expected_result: The alert() is not executed. Input is rendered as plain text or rejected. No script execution occurs.
